items.headline: UTSA holds off UAB 19-17 to maintain top spot in American Conference
items.description: — Will Henderson III ran for 93 yards and A'Marion Peterson scored a touchdown and UTSA held on to beat UAB 19-17 on Saturday.

items.headline: Peterson's 4 TDs help UTSA beat North Texas 35-16 for share of American Conference lead
items.description: — A'marion Peterson ran for career-high a 179 yards and a career-best four touchdowns and UTSA beat North Texas 35-16 on Saturday to claim a share of first place in the American Conference.
